lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 98, Schedule 1, line 21: the deduction is allowed only if "You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's (such as your parent's) 2025 tax return." The reply leaves out that condition, saying no supplied input states it; the request's person collection carries person.sav_claimed, which the project counts in sli.claimed_count (sli.eligible). As ruled on 2026-11-10, 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-15, completed returns where a person on the return is claimed (stage11.sli.claimed, stage11.sli.spouse_claimed) take $0 in the project and the worksheet amount in the reply. The review was occasioned by the reworded list of unqualified loans (BUG-0881); the expression is unchanged.

Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 99, Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet, line 1, "Enter the total interest you paid in 2025 on qualified student loans ... Don't enter more than $2,500". As ruled on 2026-11-14, -15 and -17: both take the interest less the unqualified and assisted amounts, floored at zero and capped at $2,500 (subtracting the two in turn from a zero-floored amount equals subtracting their sum); the project asks sli.any only on a return that is not married filing separately (sli.any_if_not_mfs), the reply reads it on every return, and sli.unqualified_any and sli.assisted_any only after sli.any. The new item of sli.unqualified_any (study not toward a credential, or at a school that is not eligible; i1040gi p. 99) changes its wording, not this expression.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The worksheet gives no amount for married filing separately, which cannot take the deduction; the project enters zero there and the second enters $85,000. Neither reaches Schedule 1 line 21: sli.deduction is zero for married filing separately.
Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 6 is used only when line 4 is more than line 5 (line 8 skips it otherwise), where the signed difference and the floored one are the same.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project skips to zero when line 4 is not more than line 5, as the worksheet says; the second always applies the ratio, which then has a part of zero or less, and prorate keeps the ratio at 0 or more, so it also gives zero (the same argument as the classified mutant on sli.line8).
Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 8 never exceeds line 1: prorate's ratio is at most 1.000 (Lean lemma prorate_le_amount), so the floor at zero never applies.
